description: We are THE NASA INTERNS, a multidisciplinary team of Computer Science and Engineering undergraduates from Cairo competing in NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026. Blending backend automation, spatial database engineering, AI workflows, and visual storytelling, we are building SparkGrid—an interactive web platform that harmonizes two decades of NASA MODIS and VIIRS thermal satellite data to track global wildfires and seasonal agricultural burns across Egypt's Nile Delta.
